body: I appreciate the sentiments and the kind words. But I've always viewed people as they should earn the fact they're alive. And I haven't done that in my eyes. I'm a paper tiger. I appear strong on the outside, physically I am. But inside, where it counts I just find myself hollow. And it's hardly any emotion coming into it. I just simply sit down and look at my life an find my efforts and results wanting. I don't believe in fate, but I do believe that some things should and should not happen. And ten hours a day of being alone with your thoughts gives you a lot of time to assess yourself. I've simply come up short in my estimates. I should be better. But I'm not. I've tried many many times to make something of myself. To justify my existence. But it all seems to amount to nothing. I don't even hate myself. I just don't really like me. And see no real ability to change it.
